Name: Do / own
Definition: Work the owner personally does and is accountable for finishing.

Name: Raise/influence
Definition: Something the owner should bring up or push for but doesn't control.

Name: Standing posture
Definition: An ongoing stance or default the owner keeps; no finish line.

Name: Team norms
Definition: A team practice the owner models or reinforces.

Name: Watch/risk
Definition: A risk or situation to monitor; act only if it changes.

Name: Others' work
Definition: Someone else owns it; the owner is waiting on them by a follow-up date.
